# Stop Chasing Global Variable

Source: [4464](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4464); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Stop Chasing Global Variable](../../api/actions/stop-chasing-global-variable.md).
